learning_objective: 🎯 Discover the fair way to slice and share things by exploring the awesome world of parts and wholes!

main_concepts.concept_title: 🍕 Slicing the Pizza (Parts of a Whole)
main_concepts.simple_explanation: A fraction is just a mathematical way to show a piece of something bigger. If you cut a pizza into 4 equal slices and eat 1, you just ate one-fourth of the pizza!

Every fraction has two parts. The bottom number (Denominator) tells us how many equal pieces make up the whole thing, and the top number (Numerator) tells us how many of those pieces we actually have.
Sometimes fractions look different but mean the exact same thing! Half a pizza is exactly the same amount of food as two-fourths of a pizza. We call these equivalent fractions.

fun_activity.title: 🍫 The Chocolate Bar Split
fun_activity.instructions: Grab a chocolate bar that has little squares. Count the total number of squares (that is your denominator). Break off a piece to share with a friend and write down the fraction of what you gave away!

quick_recap: ⭐ Fractions represent equal parts of a whole object or a collection.
⭐ The denominator goes down on the bottom, showing total pieces.
⭐ You can multiply the top and bottom of a fraction by the same number to find an equivalent fraction.
